name: world-war-mouse
description: A 3D firework battle game: mouse soldier vs. the cat army. 世界大战鼠

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/lib && cp index.html game.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest icon-*.png og-image.png www/ && cp lib/three.min.js www/lib/
scripts.cap:init: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build:www && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build:www && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
